guide.description: Arrange music with the bundled Roland GS sound bank, a piano roll and a six-track sequencer.

controls.action: Enable audio, then tap Play to hear the built-in eight-bar demo.
Play or stop; Stop returns to the first bar.
See all six tracks; tap a cell to open that track and bar.
The six-track arrangement shows colored blocks in bars with notes. Tap a block to edit it.
Tap an empty sixteenth-note cell to add a note, or an existing note to delete it. Tap piano keys to audition.
Choose a GM sound for the current track. The Drums button selects percussion.
Cycle Arrange, Piano Roll and Sounds.
Add a note at the current length, or delete the note in that cell.
Move to the previous or next bar.
Set the length of new notes.
Move the visible pitch range down or up.
Length of new notes: 3, 6, 12 or 24 ticks.
Mute or unmute the current track.
When enabled, return to the first bar after the last bar.

sections.title: Audio and limits
sections.text: Notes are scheduled on the audio thread at sample boundaries. Six tracks share 64 voices; the oldest voice is stolen when needed. The SF2 samples, layers, loops and envelopes are used, but SF2 filters and LFO modulation are not implemented. GM drum keys include 36 kick, 38 snare and 42 closed hat.

sections.title: Saved project
sections.text: Tempo, loop mode, track sounds and notes save automatically and return when you reopen the App. Existing projects and custom track names are preserved.
